messages:
alex: Anyone up for swapping jerseys for tonight's watch? I bought an extra home kit — size M. free if someone can pick up from the office before 6pm.
maria: I'll take it if Alex saves me a seat! :raised_hands:
shawn: Also — small proposal re: our office playoff pool tiebreaker: whoever has the best last-week points total wins. simple. Thoughts?
omar: I'm pro "closest total points in last game" instead. less fiddly.
lina: Or coin flip. always fair. :coin:
alex: Ha coin flip would trigger chaos
maria: Will there be snacks at the pub watch? I can bring pretzels.
shawn: Pretzels + hot sauce please yes
dev-bot: Reminder: Office Watch Party RSVP form due today: https://tiny.redwood/watch-rsvp
omar: Quick trade question for fantasy: anyone want my WR2 (low-floor, high-ceil) for a guaranteed RB2? ping me in DMs
lina: I can trade WR2 for RB2 if there's flex space
alex: Jersey reserved for Maria — leave it on my desk with a sticky.
maria: Thank you! :heart: See y'all tonight 7pm at The Dock
shawn: Tiebreaker settled: closest to final game's combined score. -shawn :checkered_flag:
omar: Fine, but coin if it's still tied. :coin:
lina: :thumbsup:
